entities.summary: Clemens Arnold is a field hockey goalkeeper from Germany, who was born in Australia. He was the goalkeeper for the German Men's National Team from 1998 to 2004. He retired from the national team after winning the bronze medal at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens.
